feature_name: Revenue and community path retrospective record
scope_summary: Record the earlier contact, privacy, revenue, and community route changes so release governance reflects the user-facing paths already merged.

legal_and_regulatory.rationale: Public support, privacy, and revenue paths are documented without medical or financial promises.
evidence: Public privacy and terms routes are part of the reviewed change
Revenue links are disclosed as third-party or direct support paths

privacy_local_first_promise.rationale: The changes preserve local-first defaults and disclose optional external services rather than silently sending data.
evidence: Third-party store links leave Divergify in a disclosed way

medical_scope_and_claims.rationale: No medical or treatment claim is introduced.

user_benefit_and_harm_check.rationale: Reliable contact, privacy, and support paths reduce user confusion and make help reachable.
evidence: Privacy and data-control routes remain discoverable

brand_voice_and_claims.rationale: The paths use transparent, non-coercive Divergify language.

accessibility_and_inclusion.rationale: Core support and privacy destinations remain reachable through visible links.
evidence: Support and privacy links are public
Community content is intended to have a stable route

security_and_reliability.rationale: The record covers user-facing routing and does not add runtime dependencies.
evidence: Static routes and contact wiring are documented

monetization_and_dark_pattern_check.rationale: Support and purchase paths are optional and clearly separated from the free local-first core.

ship_decision.conditions: Verify the /community route after deployment and re-run the ship filter.
